specs.note: Both SHA-1 and SHA-512 are computed in a single streaming pass (sha1::Sha1 + sha2::Sha512 updated per chunk; the old app hashed the file twice) and compared case-insensitively; a mismatch deletes the .part and returns the typed DownloadError::HashMismatch, never the file.
